about: The closed list of what a user of a design system needs done. Each capability has one socket this plugin keeps, and plugs that fill it. A socket says which ledgers of the contract only it may write (keys of LEDGERS in templates/tools/design-assembly/contract.mjs), what it hands out, which commands hold it, who decides, and its two faces: what a person is shown and asked, and what becomes a rule a machine holds. A plug here is this plugin's own; a plug from outside is one file in references/plugs/ that names the socket it fills, so this file names no outside tool. A capability with no default plug points to an open row of references/limits.json. A route is a command that leads a person through several sockets; it is not a plug. `reads` on a plug names ledgers its scripts read and do not write. `unseen_writes` names ledgers whose writers the static check cannot see, each with the limit row that says so. A socket marked `closed` takes no plug from outside: it is the core. A socket marked `ladder` keeps its plugin's plug as the one that works it, and a plug from outside there is a rung on that plug's ladder of stores, reached once the repository pins it as a source, not a rival the owner is asked to choose (spec 0015). A machine face whose rule no check holds yet says `unheld` with the limit row that says so, instead of `held_by`. A plug marked `step_of` is the step of a route that the list of spec 0008 names by the route. A plug marked `writes_through` writes the ledgers of the socket it names, in that socket's shape, instead of ledgers of its own: a route through its socket may write them too.

capabilities.name: audit
capabilities.plain: Says how far the design system has got and what it still lacks.

outputs: the audit report and the tier reached

human.shows: each decision's state and the tier the repository has reached

machine.rules: a decision counts as held only when a check that can fail holds it

capabilities.name: store inventory
capabilities.plain: Takes stock of the blocks and components the repository already has.

outputs: findings of the store, by ledger

human.shows: what each store holds, the state of each piece, and what was not looked at

machine.rules: a finding names the ledger row it comes from

capabilities.name: discovery
capabilities.plain: Sets the few principles the design favours when two good options pull apart.

outputs: the design principles and the product context

human.shows: the principles proposed for this product
human.asks: which principles the owner fixes, before any value

machine.rules: every recommendation says what it rests on

capabilities.name: reference
capabilities.plain: Gathers real products to look at before a choice is made.

outputs: a row of the sources ledger, pinned

human.shows: the references gathered for a choice

machine.rules: a source is pinned to the version or date it was fetched at

capabilities.name: direction
capabilities.plain: Shows whole looks on the product's own screen so the owner picks one.

outputs: candidate directions, drawn on the repository's own screen

human.shows: three whole directions on a real screen, light and dark

machine.rules: the chosen values reach the stylesheet with a contrast check

capabilities.name: decision
capabilities.plain: Puts every open question to the owner and records the answers.

outputs: a decision row with a name and a date

human.shows: every question that waits, each with a recommendation and what it rests on
human.asks: the owner's answer, in one touch

machine.rules: only the owner's answer is written as a decision

capabilities.name: foundations
capabilities.plain: Turns the chosen look into colours, type, spacing and corners that are checked.

outputs: the stylesheet, the design tokens, and the checks around them

human.reason: the values are the owner's, asked at the direction and decision sockets

machine.rules: no raw colour, size, distance or radius outside the stylesheet

capabilities.name: brand assets
capabilities.plain: Keeps the fonts, logo and icons the product uses, and where each comes from.

outputs: the fonts, as rows of the sources ledger recorded through the reference socket; the logo and the icon set have no place yet

human.shows: the fonts the repository loads, and where each comes from
human.asks: which font the product uses, and the licence a font is used under

machine.rules: a typeface the stylesheet names is loaded, and a font of the sources ledger is chosen only with its pin and its licence

capabilities.name: components
capabilities.plain: Takes a block in for a need, or finds the one the repository already has.

outputs: a row of the intake ledger, and the component manifest

human.shows: the ladder of three rungs for a need
human.asks: which block the repository takes in

machine.rules: a screen uses the component the manifest names, with a variant it declares

capabilities.name: interaction patterns
capabilities.plain: Says what a screen shows while it loads, when it is empty and when it fails.

outputs: the behaviours page and the table of states

human.shows: what each state of a screen shows
human.asks: which states and widths the product keeps

machine.rules: every screen draws each state it declares, at the narrowest and the widest width

capabilities.name: content
capabilities.plain: Keeps the words the product uses for each thing.

outputs: the table of terms

human.shows: the words a screen uses for each thing

machine.rules: a screen uses the term the table gives

capabilities.name: screen kinds
capabilities.plain: Keeps a model screen for each kind of screen.

outputs: the page of one kind of screen

human.shows: the model screen of a kind
human.asks: what a screen of this kind must hold

machine.rules: a screen of a kind is built from its model

capabilities.name: screen brief
capabilities.plain: Hands the builder of one screen one sheet of what is settled and what is open.

outputs: one sheet for one screen of the ledger of screens, built or declared ahead: twelve slots, each settled with where it says so, asked with the question that waits, or open with the call that asks it
with --queue, each open slot as one new question of the waiting list

human.shows: the twelve slots of one screen: what is settled and where it says so, what waits on the owner, and what is still open
human.asks: each open slot, as a question of the decision sheet with a recommendation and what it rests on; the brief asks none itself and answers none

machine.rules: a builder has one answer for each choice of its screen: the command ends with 1 while a slot is asked or open, and with 0 once all twelve are settled

capabilities.name: screen build
capabilities.plain: Builds a screen from the rules without guessing.

outputs: code that passes the gate
a browser test that opens each built screen as each role of the domain model, where the repository keeps its file of ways in

human.reason: the builder asks nothing; what is not decided goes to the waiting list

machine.rules: a screen is built only from the rules page, and the gate holds every rule it names

capabilities.name: design review
capabilities.plain: Looks at a built screen and says what to change.

outputs: findings, measured or seen by an eye, each with its picture and what it rests on: a row of the decisions ledger, a line of the rules page, a principle the owner fixed, or nothing
for each finding, the line for the ledger of escapes, the question for the waiting list, or that it is for a person's eye
pictures of a screen and a pack for a reviewer

human.shows: the findings a check cannot settle
human.asks: whether a finding becomes a rule or waits

machine.rules: a finding that names a ledger row is held by that row's check

capabilities.name: accessibility report
capabilities.plain: Says which accessibility level the product meets and where it falls short.

outputs: a conformance report

human.shows: the conformance level and what is not met

machine.rules: each criterion of the level names the check that measures it

capabilities.name: showcase and hand-over
capabilities.plain: Draws the system as a book people can read and hand over.

outputs: the handoff book and the release notes

human.shows: the system drawn from the repository, with a do and a don't for each rule

machine.rules: the book is drawn from the ledgers and says when it no longer matches them

capabilities.name: shared across repositories
capabilities.plain: Keeps blocks alike across two repositories.

outputs: decision records and blocks raised to a shared store

human.shows: the blocks two repositories keep alike
human.asks: which block is raised to the shared store

machine.rules: a repository takes a shared block in through the intake ledger

capabilities.name: upgrade and change
capabilities.plain: Brings a newer tool in, and says what a change reaches before it is made.

outputs: the ledgers changed in step, and a green gate

human.shows: what a change reaches before it is made

machine.rules: nothing is written when an entry would be lost or the gate would be red

capabilities.name: governance
capabilities.plain: Keeps every known limit and every slip, each with its plan.

outputs: the limits ledger and the ledger of escapes

human.shows: every known limit and every escape, with its plan

machine.rules: a limit written only in prose is a row of the limits ledger
